{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", data.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(data.head())

# Check for sentinel values and data types
print("\nUnique values in customer_age:", data['customer_age'].unique())
print("\nUnique values in revenue:", data['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # First 10 to check format

# Check for QA orders
print("\nQA orders (revenue == 999999.99):")
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue']])

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nRefunded orders:")
refunded = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(refunded[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'revenue']])

# Check for missing values in key columns
print("\nMissing values in converted:", data['converted'].isnull().sum())
print("Missing values in channel:", data['channel'].isnull().sum())
print("Missing values in customer_segment:", data['customer_segment'].isnull().sum())

# Display data types
print("\nData types:")
print(data.dtypes)"}
